companyFounding.title: Found your first company
companyFounding.description: Hire a CEO, configure runtime and provider, create company documents, until your first engineer can work.

firstProjectPractice.title: First project practice: Classic Snake
firstProjectPractice.description: Run requirements, design, development, testing, acceptance and delivery on a scoped-down Snake project. Skippable, and restartable later.

library.title: Tutorial library
library.description: The core tutorial is completed by doing real work. The project practice can be skipped entirely and restarted from here.
library.skipConfirmBody: No project is created, no agent is called, no tokens are spent. You can restart it later from the tutorial center.
library.skippedWithCost: Skipped: no project data was created

practice.dialogBody: This hands the project to your AI employees for real execution.
practice.accelerated: Estimated mode: Tutorial Accelerated (scoped-down demo project)
practice.usesLlm: These employees are bound to a real model service, so running the project consumes tokens.
practice.mockOnly: Every employee runs on a mock runtime, so there is no model cost.
practice.noEmployees: No runnable employee is configured yet. Finish the runtime and provider steps of the core tutorial first.
practice.mockOption: Want to see the flow with zero cost?
practice.mockOptionHint: Switch the employee runtime to Mock, then start the practice here.

company_setup.label: Meet your new company
company_setup.explanation: This is a completely empty AI company. Human accounts make decisions; AI Employees are explicitly hired and persist as staff.

hire_ceo.label: Hire your first CEO
hire_ceo.explanation: Use the real Employee Onboarding Wizard to hire leadership. The tutorial never creates fake employees.
hire_ceo.why: The CEO owns later decisions and reviews. Without an ACTIVE CEO there is no approver who can pass a project review.

configure_ceo_runtime.label: Give the CEO a runtime
configure_ceo_runtime.explanation: Employee is identity, Runtime is the execution environment. Mock runtimes are labelled as such, never presented as real execution.
configure_ceo_runtime.why: Auditability comes from separating three layers: identity, execution environment and model service. Swapping models should not mean swapping employees.

configure_ceo_provider.label: Bind provider and model
configure_ceo_provider.explanation: Provider supplies the model service, Model is what actually gets called. Only a binding with a stored credential counts as configured.
configure_ceo_provider.why: A provider without a credential looks configured but fails on the first run, so the tutorial requires the secret to actually be stored.

configure_company_resources.label: Assign workspace and access
configure_company_resources.explanation: Provisioning creates the employee's workspace, document space and access package. The Git account can wait, but its status must be visible.
configure_company_resources.why: Employee output has to land somewhere traceable: workspace for code, document space for collaboration, access package for permissions.

cloud_docs.label: Create the first company document
cloud_docs.explanation: Use Markdown for agent collaboration; use DOCX or PDF export for formal customer material.

git_setup.label: Connect Git
git_setup.explanation: Install built-in Gitea or connect GitLab, Gitea, GitHub Enterprise, or another compatible service.

hire_engineer.label: Hire your first engineer
hire_engineer.explanation: Run real provisioning again to assign a runtime, workspace, documents and permissions to the engineer.
hire_engineer.why: Only now does the company hold both a decision-maker and an executor, which is what the core tutorial is aiming at.

configure_engineer.label: Make the engineer runnable
configure_engineer.explanation: An engineer needs ACTIVE identity, a runtime, a valid provider binding and a workspace before work can be assigned.
configure_engineer.why: Missing any one of those four, tasks stall at dispatch; the tutorial checks the same business gates the scheduler does.

hire_qa.label: Check QA coverage
hire_qa.explanation: Independent QA supports separation of duties. You can defer it and the project will retain a coverage reminder.

create_project.label: Create the Classic Snake project
create_project.explanation: Start from the sample Structured Project Intake and confirm requirements, constraints, deliverables and review plan.

requirements_review.label: Complete requirements review
requirements_review.explanation: AI has prepared the analysis; a human must approve the requirements baseline before system design can start.
requirements_review.why: The requirements baseline is the origin of the whole traceability chain: design, tasks, tests and acceptance all reference it.

design_review.label: Complete design review
design_review.explanation: Inspect system design, review slides, speaker notes and traceability, then make the human decision.

development.label: Inspect development output
development.explanation: Review staff, tasks, repositories, branches, commits, artifacts and activity to verify real team work.

testing.label: Complete internal and acceptance testing
testing.explanation: Internal testing covers defects and regression; acceptance testing verifies customer-visible criteria.

acceptance_review.label: Run acceptance review
acceptance_review.explanation: The final Human Gate: a person confirms acceptance evidence and the delivery preview.
acceptance_review.why: The last human confirmation before delivery is Eidolon's floor: AI prepares the evidence, a person decides it can go to the customer.

delivery.label: Generate the final delivery package
delivery.explanation: The package brings together source, builds, DOCX, PPTX, manuals, release notes, minutes and checklists.

hints.identity: Confirm identity first — this decides who they are; no fake tutorial employee.
hints.pickRuntime: Pick the execution environment. Mock runtimes are labelled Mock, never faked as real.
hints.pickProvider: Pick the model service. Only bindings with a stored credential count as usable.
hints.pickAccess: Assign access packages and resources: workspace, document space and git accounts get created here.
hints.engineerAccess: The second employee goes through the same real provisioning; only key differences are called out.
hints.confirmOnboard: Review and hire. After submitting, the tutorial waits until this CEO's runtime and workspace really exist.
hints.openRuntimeTab: The binding lives in the Runtime tab — switch to it first.
hints.bindProvider: Create the provider here with a model: a create that stores key + model also creates the binding the tutorial trusts.
